navigationLaw: After Draven falls, the game gives the player a quiet physical aftermath on La Liberacion before credits. The ending acknowledges Ethan, crew and world consequences without a morality score screen.

actors.name: C10_05_Ethan
actors.text: For the first time in months, I do not know where we have to sail next. I think that is a good thing.

actors.name: C10_05_Mira
actors.text: The sea did not become kinder. We just get to choose our own course through it again.

actors.name: C10_05_BigTom
actors.text: Eat something before you decide to save the world again.

actors.name: C10_05_Esteban
actors.text: There are still wars, ports and debts out there. But this one ends here.

creditsHandoff.status: native credits presentation still requires materialisation/runtime wiring
